The '''Tharkos system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tharkos]],<ref name="Twitter" /> its [[Moon/Legends|moon]], and at least one other planet.<ref name="The Flight of the Falcon" />
